title: Omuweereza w’Amagezi Agakwekeddwa
intro: Mu tapestry ennene ey’ennyonnyola za Quran, waliwo ekifaananyi eky’ekyama, omuweereza wa Allah eyasiimibwa okumanya n’okusaasira okw’obwakatonda. Omuntu ono ow’ekyama yasala amakubo n’omu ku bannabbi abakulu, ekyamuviirako olugendo olwali lujjudde ebikolwa ebisomooza ebyasomooza ekkomo ly’okutegeera kw’omuntu. Buli kikolwa, wadde nga kyalabika ng’ekitali kya bwenkanya, kyakweka eby’okuyiga eby’amaanyi ebikwata ku nkomerero, obugumiikiriza, n’amagezi agatalabika emabega w’ekiragiro kya Katonda. Omusajja ono ow’ekisiikirize y’ani, era mazima ki ge baabikkula?
clues: Nnali muweereza wa Allah, eyalondebwa olw’okumanya n’okusaasira okw’enjawulo.
Nnabbi omukulu yafuba okuyigirako, era ne nzikiriziganya mu bukwakkulizo obukakali.
Mu lukuŋŋaana lwaffe, nnakola ebikolwa bisatu ebyalabika ng’ebitali bya bwenkanya eri munnange.
Nnayonoona eryato eryali ery’abantu abaavu, naye ate nga lyali kisa ekikusike.
Natwala obulamu bw’omulenzi omuto, wadde nga bwalabika ng’obukambwe, bwali bwa kuwonya bazadde be ennaku.
Nnaddamu okuzimba bbugwe mu kibuga ekyali kitugaana okusembeza abagenyi, ne kibikkula eky’obugagga wansi waakyo.

arabic: فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًۭا مِّنْ عِبَادِنَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلْمًۭا
verse: And they found a servant from among Our servants [i.e., al-Khiḍr] to whom We had given mercy from Us and had taught him from Us a [certain] knowledge. (18:65)
